Le MC Oran prend les commandes en solo: MC Oran takes sole control of the standings
Les Hamraoua ont empoché le point du mat: The Hamraoua secured a draw in Algiers against JS El Biar, allowing them to claim sole possession of first place in the standings with a total of fourteen points. Having traveled with the firm ambition of clinching a third consecutive win, the visitors fell short of that goal but will settle for this away point against a strong opponent. MCO had to finish the match with ten players following the expulsion of the Gabonese player Matouti in the fifty-fifth minute. Meanwhile, the El Biarois tried everything to win, without success, thus maintaining their seventh position with eight points.
Dans l'autre rencontre de l'après-midi,: In the afternoon's other match, Olympique Akbou clearly defeated CS Constantine with a score of three goals to zero. For their second consecutive home outing, the Akbouciens opened the scoring as early as the thirteenth minute through Hitala, before doubling their lead at the start of the second half thanks to Zamoum in the forty-seventh minute, and then adding a third through Feth-Allah in the fifty-seventh minute. With ten points, OA joins JS Kabylie and USM Alger in fourth position. On the other hand, CS Constantine, playing without a coach since the dismissal of Tunisian Mondher Kebaïer, suffered a third consecutive defeat and remains provisionally in ninth place with seven points.
La suite de cette septième journée se dé: The rest of this seventh matchday will take place this Saturday, featuring notably the capital derby between USM Alger and CR Belouizdad at the 5 July 1962 Stadium, as well as four other fixtures scheduled across the country. The conclusion of this round will take place on Tuesday with reigning champions MC Alger traveling to face US Biskra.
Le MC Oran est seul leader du championna: MC Oran is the sole leader of the Ligue 1 Mobilis championship with fourteen points after their draw against JS El Biar.
L'Olympique Akbou s'est imposé trois but: Olympique Akbou won three goals to zero against CS Constantine thanks to goals from Hitala, Zamoum, and Feth-Allah.
Le CS Constantine enchaîne un troisième: CS Constantine suffered a third consecutive defeat and finds itself in ninth place with seven points, still without a coach following the departure of Mondher Kebaïer.
Le derby de la capitale opposant l'USM A: The capital derby between USM Alger and CR Belouizdad is scheduled for this Saturday at the 5 July 1962 Stadium.
